user.title: Choose your city
user.description: Cineville shows screenings in the participating cinemas of this city.

venues.title: Choose cinemas
venues.description: Which cinemas in {city} should be included? If you keep all of them selected, cinemas that join Cineville later are added automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the Cineville login
reauth_confirm.description:
The Cineville login has expired.

1. [Open the Cineville login]({url}) and log in with your email address and the code Cineville sends you.
2. You end up on a blank page. That's expected. Press **Ctrl+U** (view page source) and find the line with `name="code"`.
3. Copy the text inside `value="…"` and paste it below (pasting the whole line works too).

The code is valid for about 5 minutes and only works with this link. This is easiest on a computer.
